time_comparison_method: Subtract endpoints within each separately labelled same-day interval. Compare durations without selecting a local timezone or translating either endpoint into historical UTC. Different described scopes could be intended; no source preferred.
fixed_offset_test: Compare numeric endpoint differences separately. A single constant offset cannot make0800→1200 and1200→1605both exact; this is a conditional label-alignment result, not measured drift/gap.

prior_memo_context.limit: Different named positions and source/copy scopes; the October10landline memo neither proves a repair nor contradicts every October8assertion. Same facility/date proximity is not a source-to-copy join.
